objective: Execute GCL-01 — Construction Taxonomy & Reusable Template Grammar. Define the reusable template-family taxonomy, stable identity/version metadata, typed slot semantics, compatibility constraints, provenance classes, dual ready-to-use/construction-material projections, composition contracts, and versioned import/export shape that later GCL library families can share.

acceptance_profile.taxonomy: Defines stable template-family identifiers covering the approved GCL roadmap without prematurely authoring later-tranche content libraries.
acceptance_profile.shared_metadata: Defines stable identity, version, lifecycle, discovery, authority, compatibility, provenance and uncertainty metadata reusable across GCL families.
acceptance_profile.slot_semantics: Defines typed required/optional/repeatable slots, cardinality, allowed origins, visibility, replaceability, unresolved-state behavior and compatibility constraints without silent defaults.
acceptance_profile.authority_boundary: A GCL template remains proposal/authoring material until an owning domain explicitly incorporates it; no Campaign, Scene, Encounter, Session, canon, entitlement, permission or balance authority is created by the template.
acceptance_profile.dual_projection: Defines ready-to-use and construction-material projections from the same template record without duplicating authority or losing provenance.
acceptance_profile.composition: Defines deterministic/manual composition lineage, compatibility checks, unresolved-slot handling, conflict preservation and optional-AI proposal boundaries.
acceptance_profile.interchange: Defines a versioned package shape for import/export with dependency, provenance, conflict and checksum metadata; import never silently overwrites or promotes authority.
acceptance_profile.difficulty_boundary: Preserves F012/PPIA-11 independent pressure dimensions and uncertainty; no universal Challenge Rating, balance scalar or guarantee is introduced.
acceptance_profile.validation: Exact candidate passes AIOC repository-health validation and artifact cross-reference review before completed_verified closeout.

nonauthorization: automatic start of GCL-02 or another successor merely by GCL-01 completion
next_action: On the next explicit Continue GCL with no narrower successor selection, start GCL-02 — Hook, Premise & Inciting-Situation Library. GCL-03, GCL-04, GCL-05, GCL-06 and GCL-13 are also dependency-ready parallel successors.
